segmentation.text: a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter
the driver of a motor vehicle
If there is only one lane for traffic proceeding in the same direction,
pass to the left of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter
at a safe distance, which must be not less than 3 feet between any portion of the vehicle and the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter,
and shall not move again to the right side of the highway
until the vehicle is safely clear of the overtaken bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter.
Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.213 and 484B.217 [NRS-484B-213-1, NRS-484B-213-2a, NRS-484B-213-2b, NRS-484B-213-2c, NRS-484B-217-2],

when passing to the left of a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter at a safe distance of not less than 3 feet between any portion of the vehicle and the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter, this paragraph authorizes the driver, if it is safe, to pass: (1) To the left of the center of the highway. (2) In a no-passing zone.

elements.justification: 'overtaking or passing' a road user proceeding the same way is drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, r): 'a, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it to having b behind it'; it denotes the relative motion only, the side being read by b7. The pass is under way while the bodies are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero; a projection, not a contact or a distance), within the window behind the pass's recognition.

'a bicycle' is DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle ('a device propelled by human power upon which a person may ride'), 'an electric bicycle' DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle, 'an electric scooter' DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter ('a vehicle with handlebars and an electric motor that is designed to be ridden on'); each admitted aggregate claimed whole.
'proceeding' is the overtaken road user moving (kin.speed above the halt tolerance); 'in the same direction' is rel.same_direction ('headings aligned') between the subject and it.
'a motor vehicle' is DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle ('every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails'). 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

'only one lane for traffic proceeding in the same direction' is the count of lanes in the direction of a lane (st.lane) the overtaken rider occupies (rel.occupies) being the stated one (st.lane_adjacency, 'the count of lanes in that direction'; not the marking between lanes). 'traffic' names the users of the lane; no membership is read.

'pass to the left of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter' (the overtaken road user of b2, its aggregates claimed again for these words): at every observation of the pass at which the two are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero), the rider lies on the subject's right: the lateral component of its bearing in the subject's frame (rel.bearing, 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for "on the right of" ...)') is negative.

operationalizations.standard: at a safe distance, which must be not less than 3 feet between any portion of the vehicle and the bicycle
operationalizations.convention: lateral passing clearance: the distance between the nearest points of the two bodies (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies', which is the distance between any portion of the vehicle and the rider's device) is at least the larger of the stated 3 feet and the bicyclist operating-space clearance the reading sets, at every observation at which the two are side by side

residues.why: the authorization lets a driver passing a rider at the stated clearance pass left of the center or in a no-passing zone, conduct other rules (NRS 484B.213, 484B.217) forbid; it relaxes those rules and leaves the duty to pass on the left at a safe distance unchanged

applicability: The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle. At the observation, drv.interaction.overtake_pass(subject, r) rises, with window p.overtake_window and same_dir_cos p.overtake_same_direction_cos, for some road user r, not the subject, a member of DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle, DEF-NRS-484B-017::electric_bicycle or DEF-NRS-484B-018::electric_scooter, which at some observation of that window was moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) with its heading aligned with the subject's (rel.same_direction, p.overtake_same_direction_cos); and at some observation of that window at which the two were side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero), r occupied a st.lane whose count of lanes in its direction (st.lane_adjacency count) is the literal one.
obligation: For every such r (re-bound with its whole selection): at every observation of the window behind of length p.overtake_window at which the subject and r are side by side (rel.longitudinal_overlap at or above zero), r lies on the subject's right (rel.bearing from the subject, lateral component negative) and the gap between their bodies (rel.surface_gap) is at least the larger of the literal 3 ft and p.bicycle_pass_safe_gap.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' of a motor vehicle is read through the vehicle's controlled motion
'a safe distance' is read as one lateral clearance the reading sets, never below the stated 3 feet; the clearance does not grow with the subject's speed

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: Road with one lane in the subject's direction; a bicycle rides in it. The subject car overtakes the bicycle on its left with a body-to-body gap below 3 feet while side by side.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same pass, the subject car keeping a gap above both 3 feet and the safe-gap clearance while side by side, the bicycle on its right.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject car overtakes another car on a one-lane road; no bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter is in the scene. The duty binds the subject alone.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source does not observe the gap between bodies.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject car overtakes an electric scooter on the scooter's right, with a wide gap: while side by side the scooter lies on the subject's left.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The road has two lanes in the subject's direction; the subject passes a bicycle.
